Description

The 2015 Toyota Prius is the most economical car in our fleet and the obvious pick if you plan to cover a lot of ground in Adjara. The 1.8-litre hybrid drivetrain averages about 4.5 L/100 km, and it actually uses less in town than on the motorway: at Batumi traffic lights the petrol engine simply shuts off. A week of active driving means roughly one visit to the petrol station.

It is particularly easy on the mountain roads towards Khulo and Mtirala. The automatic transmission removes any gear shifting on long climbs, and the low centre of gravity keeps the car predictable on wet asphalt. Its compact footprint helps when parking in the old town or along the Batumi boulevard, where space is always tight.

Inside there are five proper seats, and the 445-litre boot swallows two large suitcases plus hand luggage. Air conditioning, rear-view camera, cruise control and Bluetooth are all included. Left-hand drive, automatic gearbox, front-wheel drive.

Suitable for trips across the whole of Georgia: Tbilisi, Kutaisi and Borjomi are all within reach with no mileage limit.
